investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large number of SharePoint file downloads (840 vs a 24-hour baseline of 4) was observed for the user, spanning payroll, contracts, patents, engineering drawings, and other high-sensitivity directories. The activity originated from Vilnius, Lithuania and occurred at 2026-02-01 23:30 local time (EET), which is outside normal business hours and increases suspicion of unauthorized bulk retrieval. The combination of extreme deviation from baseline, the cross-department sensitive file set, and late-hour activity indicates a significant risk of data exfiltration and justifies escalation for deeper investigation.
